profile.description: Annual county fair centered on Niobrara County 4-H and FFA in Lusk. The 2026 community calendar listed the fair for July 20-August 1, 2026; 2027 dates were not published when reviewed September 7, 2026. Adventure Zone has targeted outreach history from 2023 and 2025, including a post-WAF Convention follow-up, but no reply was found in the matched Gmail threads. Treat as a prior-contact 2027 renewal lead, not a cold lead.

notes.subject: Gmail outreach history through September 2026
notes.body: Adventure Zone emailed the Lusk Chamber/Visit Lusk about the fair on April 5, 2023; emailed Kellie Chichester on November 21, 2023; introduced Adventure Zone to the fair board ahead of the WAF Convention on September 29, 2025; and sent the latest targeted follow-up to niobraracounty@uwyo.edu on October 14, 2025 after missing Kellie at the convention. The latest email recapped the three packages and 2026 pricing. No reply appears in the matched threads. Gmail also confirms both kelliec@uwyo.edu and niobraracounty@uwyo.edu on the 2026 Wyoming Association of Fairs distribution.

notes.subject: 2027 timing and source review
notes.body: The 2026 fair occurred July 20-August 1, so routine 2026 outreach is closed. Schedule the next individual follow-up for April 20, 2027, approximately three months before the expected 2027 fair window, unless the organizer is contacted sooner through the convention campaign. Confirm official 2027 dates before putting dates in outreach. Sources reviewed September 7, 2026: University of Wyoming Extension Niobrara County Fair page and Niobrara County Extension contact page; Explore Niobrara 2026 community calendar.

notes.subject: Individualized 2027 email draft prepared
notes.body: An unsent Gmail draft titled “Planning for the 2027 Niobrara County Fair” was prepared for Kellie Chichester, with the general fair inbox copied. It is intentionally separate from the planned broader convention email and leads with the guaranteed, fully staffed package structure.

followUps.label: 2027 Niobrara County Fair outreach
followUps.reason: About three months before the expected annual fair window, confirm the official 2027 dates and send/review the individualized guaranteed-package draft if no earlier contact occurred through the convention campaign.
